_comment: Governed Agentic Companion read/write boundary. Claude Code enforces permissions from the PROJECT/USER .claude/settings.json, NOT from a plugin's settings.json. Merge this block into your .claude/settings.json (project scope recommended) after installing the governed-agentic-companion plugin. It enforces Tenet 1 (no deployment) and Tenet 3 (read/write boundary) at the permission layer, complementing the per-agent 'disallowedTools: Bash' shipped in the plugin. The governed engine is reached through the single companion-engine server (gateway or local bridge); it is set to 'ask'.
